_comment: Asha declarative guidance-nudge rules — the advisory counterpart to policies/rules.json (policies constrain via deny/ask; nudges inform via context injection, never block). Evaluated by hooks/handlers/nudge-engine.sh, invoked with the hook event name as its first argument. User overrides/additions: ~/.asha/nudges.json (merged by id, user wins). Schema per rule: {id, event (hook event name), tool? (anchored ERE on tool_name), match_regex? (ERE on the event's text fields: prompt/command/file_path/pattern/query), match_ci? (true = case-insensitive match_regex; opt-in so existing user-layer rules keep case-sensitive behavior — a lowercase alternation without it never fires on sentence-initial capitals), harnesses? (allowlist; absent = all), disable_env? (env var whose value '0' disables the rule), marker_required? / marker_off? (Work/markers/<name> gates), silence_gated? (default true: skip when Work/markers/silence exists), requires_init? (default true: skip unless .asha/config.json exists), cooldown_hours? (engine-managed marker nudge-<id>-cooldown), priority? (default 50, lower fires first), payload: exactly one of handler (allowlisted function in handlers/nudge-builtins.sh) | inject (inline text) | inject_file (path relative to hooks/nudges/)}. Every rule additionally honors the kill-switch marker Work/markers/nudge-<id>-off.

rules._comment: Lexical memory-index awareness nudge (tools/memory_nudge.py). Claude-only, bounded (0.1s python timeout), no project gates — mirrors the retired hooks/memory_nudge.sh exactly, including the ASHA_NUDGE=0 kill switch and ASHA_NUDGE_INDEX override.

Per-turn RP routing directive, formerly inlined in handlers/harness-response.sh and emitted by user-prompt-submit.sh. The one-shot /rp setup scrolls out of the model's attention; this injection cannot. marker_off preserves the historical rp-hook-off kill switch.

Workspace v2 context on Copilot's native sessionStart additionalContext channel, verified live on Copilot CLI 1.0.78 (2026-08-08 UTC), including exact renderer payload. Codex uses its direct SessionStart raw-fragment registration instead; neither harness retains the prompt fallback. The builtin performs a bash manifest precheck before Python. Standard engine gates provide active-project init, silence, and nudge-ws-context-off. SessionStart is once per session, so no cooldown marker is used.

Session-activity compaction suggestion, formerly handlers/suggest-compact.sh. The tool-call counter lives in the builtin; the 2h cooldown is engine-managed (marker nudge-suggest-compact-cooldown replaces the legacy compact-suggested marker — one cooldown reset at migration is accepted). Harness-gated off codex (verified live 2026-07-27, codex 0.145): codex fires PostToolUse but discards hook stdout entirely, so an ungated row would burn the shared tool-count and stamp the 2h cooldown for an emission the model never sees — suppressing the nudge for a later Claude session where it works. Bare codex launches (no ASHA_HARNESS) still detect as claude and degrade to the old discard behavior; see docs/harness-enforcement.md 'Codex PostToolUse'.
